verdict.rationale: Fireflies' own marketing says it autojoins meetings to record, transcribe, and summarize, delivering detailed notes, action items, and customized summaries instantly after every meeting. That covers the post-meeting summary with next steps. The rest rests only on vendor claims: missing for 10: explicit capture of decisions as a summary section, evidence of a structured key-points/decisions/next-steps format, independent or hands-on proof that summaries are accurate enough to share without editing, and documentation of sharing the summary itself rather than the transcript.

support.subject: As a product manager, I get a structured summary right after each meeting — key points, decisions, and next steps — good enough to share without editing

citations.quote: Get detailed notes, action items, and customized summaries instantly after every meeting.
